Who are we

we make modern, eclectic sound

Comet Records is a record label dedicated to promoting and showcasing the finest in progressive house, organic house, and melodic techno. Established in 2018, the label is headquartered in both London and Pakistan and has since become a respected name within the global electronic music community.

The label has a strong focus on discovering and nurturing new talent, providing a platform for emerging producers and musicians to showcase their work. Comet Records is passionate about supporting artists, providing them with the necessary resources to produce high-quality music, including professional mixing, mastering, and audio solutions.
